units_and_population.coverage: Valid current-minute quotes / scheduled slots in retrospective observed universe; listed denominator remains separate

decision_clock.quote_timestamp_evidence: SOURCE-OPTIONS as-of/revealed-minute contract and inspected one-minute Greeks records; source timestamp is used only as the record clock, not a verified original update clock.
decision_clock.underlying_bar_evidence: User verified 2026-11-10: 09:30 summarizes 09:30-09:31 and is available at 09:31.

units_and_population.mean: Equal mean of contributing expiration-level cell means, conditional on valid required observations
units_and_population.population: Every observed contract in scheduled exact cohort; observed-universe denominator is retrospective and is not a listing claim
units_and_population.price_units: Quoted option price units; USD only when actual multiplier is verified
units_and_population.quantiles: Within-expiration observed quantiles; cross-expiration quantiles describe expiration cell means, not pooled quotes
units_and_population.sampled_hits: One-minute observed midpoint grid; missing-data bounds, not confidence intervals or fills
units_and_population.uncertainty: Calendar-session block bootstrap; all co-occurring contracts and expirations move together
